evidence.notes: Local SOQL validates SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, and polymorphic relationship paths before execution.
Formula-backed calculated fields are query-readable from local record state while DML writes remain rejected by the DML layer.

source.content: List<Account> rows = [SELECT Name, Score__c FROM Account WHERE Score__c >= 2 WITH USER_MODE ORDER BY Score__c DESC LIMIT 1]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); Account first = rows.get(0); System.assertEquals('High', first.Name); Object score = first.get('Score__c'); System.assertEquals(5, score); Boolean orderCaught = false; try { Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Account ORDER BY Missing__c'); } catch (QueryException qe) { orderCaught = qe.getMessage().contains('Missing__c'); } System.assert(orderCaught); Boolean relationshipCaught = false; try { Database.query('SELECT Id FROM Task WHERE What.Missing__c = ''hidden'''); } catch (QueryException qe) { relationshipCaught = qe.getMessage().contains('What.Missing__c'); } System.assert(relationshipCaught);
